name: Willem de Groot
headline: Senior DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer
summary: Senior DevOps/SRE engineer with 8 years of experience designing and operating cloud infrastructure on AWS. Specialized in Kubernetes-based platforms, infrastructure as code with Terraform, and building reliable CI/CD pipelines. Focused on improving system observability, reducing operational toil, and mentoring junior engineers.

responsibilities: Lead migration of legacy services to Kubernetes clusters on AWS EKS
Design and maintain Terraform modules for multi-account infrastructure provisioning
Own on-call rotation and incident response processes for production systems
Mentor mid-level engineers on infrastructure best practices
Implement observability stack using Prometheus and Grafana for SLO tracking
Built CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitLab CI for microservices deployments
Automated infrastructure provisioning on AWS using Terraform and CloudFormation
Managed containerized workloads on Docker Swarm and later migrated to Kubernetes
Collaborated with development teams to improve deployment frequency and reliability
Maintained monitoring and alerting systems using Datadog
Administered Linux servers and internal network infrastructure
Assisted in setting up automated backup and monitoring solutions
Supported application deployments and troubleshooting for internal teams
Documented infrastructure configurations and operational procedures
